entries.alt: Four fictional adult women hold hands on Skopje's Vardar riverfront below the arched Stone Bridge and hilltop fortress, wearing sharply shortened crimson, gold, blue and green fashion looks with dark hosiery and heels.

Four fictional adult women pose closely on the Lake Ohrid waterfront beneath the fortress, wearing sharply shortened bronze, gold, red and blue-green looks with rainbow thigh-high stockings and star-detailed heels as one gives another a cheek greeting.

Four fictional adult women stand together at a protected Matka Canyon overlook above the emerald reservoir, wearing sharply shortened red, rose-gold, green and blue looks with rainbow-gradient stockings and complete heels.

Four fictional adult women share a warm linked pose on Bitola's Sirok Sokak below the Clock Tower, wearing short crimson, gold, blue and green looks with rainbow knee-high panels and dramatic RAZE boots on split-star heels.
